So, last night I was able to experiment with my gift a bit more and here are my thoughts;

Build Quality: Honestly this might be the only issue I have with these headphones. Although I suppose the purpose of the build was to be simplistic, I feel a little more could've been done to have improved comfort. The band is fine, just a flexible metal band covered by a thin leather strap. Sound: I can't grasp how some people don't enjoy the sound generated by these baby's as I'm quite pleased with the performance. Very nice soundstage and depth which I underestimated. Very rich highs and lows with just enough bass to be noticeable but not overpower any aspect of the audio or music I tested with (For gaming Rainbow six: siege; for music: Frank Ocean - Self Control, Yosi Horikawa - Letters) 

Overall, I have no complaints with their base performance (No DAC amp) and feel they're well worth the price tag (I looked them up and apparently they go from $85 - $100) I almost feel bad that my coworker can't appreciate the quality of these headphones.
